spreadsheet.subtitle: Yellow cells are your score picks. Blue columns show group tables that update as you go.

knockout.r16Hint: Each Round of 16 pick is the winner from one 32nd-final against the winner from another (FIFA bracket paths). Round-of-32 rows in the mall have no score cells: after you fill the group stage, we infer each 32nd-final winner from group points, goal difference, and goals scored (then alphabetical tiebreak). Third-place qualifiers must be resolved where the draw uses them.
